# docker_dockerfile (Data Source)

Reads, parses and renders one Dockerfile: from `content`, a local `path`, an https `url`, an `image` history (approximate), or written with ordered `stage` / `instruction` blocks. Every source yields the same outputs: the re-rendered `dockerfile` (+ `dockerfile_sha256`), the text as read in `source_dockerfile` (+ `source_dockerfile_sha256`), and structured `stages` (each instruction with all its flags as the object named by its lowercase keyword, JSON-encoded), `directives`, `global_args`, `exposed_ports`, `base_images`.

Builder mode keeps instruction order with one `instruction` block per instruction holding exactly one keyword block (`run`, `copy`, `env`, ...): Terraform keeps the order of blocks of one type, not across types. `onbuild = true` on a keyword block writes `ONBUILD <instruction>`. MAINTAINER is read from existing Dockerfiles but cannot be written: use `label { labels = { "org.opencontainers.image.authors" = "..." } }`. `check.skip` names outside the pinned rule list (frontend 1.28) give a warning, not an error, because a newer `syntax` may add rules.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Parse an existing Dockerfile and use its structure.
data "docker_dockerfile" "app" {
  path = "${path.module}/app/Dockerfile"
}

output "build_targets" {
  value = data.docker_dockerfile.app.stage_names
}

# Rebuild the image when the parsed Dockerfile changes.
resource "docker_image" "app" {
  name = "registry.example.com/app:latest"
  build {
    context = "${path.module}/app"
  }
  triggers = {
    dockerfile_sha256 = data.docker_dockerfile.app.dockerfile_sha256
  }
}

# Write a Dockerfile with ordered blocks: one `instruction` block per
# instruction, each holding exactly one keyword block.
data "docker_dockerfile" "generated" {
  syntax = "docker/dockerfile:1"
  check {
    skip = ["JSONArgsRecommended"]
  }

  global_arg {
    name    = "GO_VERSION"
    default = "1.22"
  }

  stage {
    name     = "build"
    from     = "golang:$${GO_VERSION}"
    platform = "$BUILDPLATFORM"
    instruction {
      workdir {
        path = "/src"
      }
    }
    instruction {
      copy {
        sources     = ["."]
        destination = "."
      }
    }
    instruction {
      run {
        shell_form = "go build -o /out/app ./cmd/app"
        mount = [
          { type = "cache", target = "/root/.cache/go-build" },
        ]
      }
    }
  }

  stage {
    from = "gcr.io/distroless/static"
    instruction {
      label {
        # MAINTAINER is deprecated: use the OCI authors label.
        labels = { "org.opencontainers.image.authors" = "ops@example.com" }
      }
    }
    instruction {
      copy {
        from        = "build"
        sources     = ["/out/app"]
        destination = "/app"
        link        = true
      }
    }
    instruction {
      expose {
        ports = [{ port = "8080" }]
      }
    }
    instruction {
      entrypoint {
        exec_form = ["/app"]
      }
    }
  }
}

# The rendered text is sensitive (ENV values and ARG defaults are inline).
output "generated_dockerfile" {
  value     = data.docker_dockerfile.generated.dockerfile
  sensitive = true
}

# Approximate Dockerfile of a local image, rebuilt from its history.
data "docker_dockerfile" "nginx" {
  image = "nginx:latest"
}
```

## Schema

### Optional

- `check` (Block, Optional) Builder mode: the `# check=` parser directive (Dockerfile 1.8) configuring build checks. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--check))
- `content` (String) Dockerfile text to parse (source `content`). Exactly one of `content`, `path`, `url`, `image` or `stage` blocks.
- `escape` (String) Builder mode: the `# escape=` parser directive, `\` (default) or a backtick (needs `stage` blocks).
- `global_arg` (Block List) Builder mode: `ARG` instructions before the first FROM, in order (usable in `stage.from`). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--global_arg))
- `image` (String) Local image (name, tag or ID) whose history is turned into an approximate Dockerfile through the Engine API (source `image`, `fidelity = "approximate"`).
- `path` (String) Local Dockerfile to read and parse (source `path`), relative to the working directory.
- `stage` (Block List) Builder mode: build stages in order (`FROM [--platform=...] <from> [AS <name>]`, Q31) and their instructions. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--stage))
- `syntax` (String) Builder mode: the `# syntax=` parser directive, e.g. `docker/dockerfile:1` (needs `stage` blocks).
- `url` (String) `https://` URL of a raw Dockerfile to download and parse (source `url`; pure Go HTTPS, no git).

### Read-Only

- `base_images` (Attributes List) External base images per stage (stage bases excluded); empty in image mode. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--base_images))
- `directives` (Attributes) Parser directives; shapes = dockerfile:directive-* items. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--directives))
- `docker_server_version` (String) Image mode only; null otherwise.
- `dockerfile` (String, Sensitive) Re-rendered Dockerfile from the structured model (directives, global ARGs, stages). ENV values and ARG defaults are inline, hence sensitive.
- `dockerfile_sha256` (String) The `dockerfile_sha256` hash output.
- `dockerfile_syntax` (String) `# syntax=` value of the parsed file, else the default frontend `docker/dockerfile:1` (pinned reference 1.28.0); null in image mode (not recorded in images).
- `engine_api_version` (String) Image mode only (the only mode that talks to the Engine); null otherwise.
- `exposed_ports` (Attributes List) EXPOSE entries of the final stage (image mode: Config.ExposedPorts). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--exposed_ports))
- `fidelity` (String) `exact` for content/path/git (parsed from the real file); `approximate` for image (see notes).
- `final_stage` (String) Name (or index) of the last stage, the default build target.
- `git_commit` (String) Always null: Git sources are not read (use `url` with a raw file URL pinned to a commit).
- `global_args` (Attributes List) ARGs declared before the first FROM (usable in FROM). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--global_args))
- `history` (Attributes List) Image mode only: GET /images/{name}/history entries the reconstruction used (CreatedBy holds build-arg values). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--history))
- `id` (String) Source locator: `content:<sha256>`, `path:<absolute path>`, `url:<url>`, `image:<image id>` or `blocks:<sha256 of the rendered text>`.
- `image_digest_ref` (String) Image mode only: the first `repo@sha256:...` of the image read; null otherwise.
- `labels` (Map of String) Union of the LABEL instructions of the final stage (image mode: the image config labels).
- `source_dockerfile` (String, Sensitive) The Dockerfile text exactly as read from content / path / url, before parsing (Q47); null in image and blocks mode.
- `source_dockerfile_sha256` (String) sha256 of `source_dockerfile` (Q34).
- `source_type` (String) Which source was read: `content`, `path`, `url`, `image` or `blocks`.
- `stage_names` (List of String) Stage names in order (unnamed stages as their index), the targets for `build.target`.
- `stages` (Attributes List) Build stages in order: name, base image (as written, resolved ref and digest when available) and every instruction with all its flags, in the dockerfile:* block model. Image mode: one stage, instructions from history CreatedBy, base unknown. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--stages))

### Nested Schema for `global_arg`

Required:

Read-Only:

Optional:

<a id="nestedatt--stage--instruction--copy--heredocs"></a>

Required:

- `expand` (Boolean) Expand build variables in the body. Default true; false quotes the delimiter (`<<"EOF"`).

<a id="nestedblock--stage--instruction--run"></a>
### Nested Schema for `stage.instruction.run`

Optional:

- `network` (String) `--network` (Dockerfile 1.3): `default`, `none` or `host` (needs the network.host entitlement).
- `onbuild` (Boolean) Wraps the instruction in `ONBUILD` (Q30): it runs when a later build uses this image as its base.
- `security` (String) `--security` (Dockerfile 1.20): `sandbox` (default) or `insecure` (needs the security.insecure entitlement).
- `shell_form` (String) The command in shell form (`RUN <command>`), run through the stage's SHELL. One line; conflicts with `exec_form`.

<a id="nestedatt--stage--instruction--run--mount"></a>
### Nested Schema for `stage.instruction.run.mount`

Optional:

- `env` (String) Expose a secret as this environment variable (Dockerfile 1.10).
- `from` (String) Build stage, context or image to mount from (bind, cache).
- `gid` (Number) Group id of the mount (default 0).
- `id` (String) Cache id, or secret / ssh id.
- `mode` (String) File mode in octal (cache 0755, secret 0400, ssh 0600 by default).
- `required` (Boolean) Fail when the secret or ssh agent is not available (default false).
- `ro` (Boolean) Read-only cache mount.
- `rw` (Boolean) Allow writes to a bind mount (discarded after the RUN).
- `sharing` (String) Cache sharing mode: `shared` (default), `private` or `locked`.
- `size` (String) Size limit of a tmpfs mount.
- `source` (String) Path in `from` (bind, cache).
- `target` (String) Mount path (required for bind, cache and tmpfs).
- `type` (String) `bind` (default), `cache`, `tmpfs`, `secret` or `ssh`.
- `uid` (Number) User id of the mount (default 0).

- `platform` (String) Upstream `--platform`.
- `stage` (String) Upstream `AS <name>`.


<a id="nestedatt--directives"></a>
### Nested Schema for `directives`

Read-Only:

- `check` (Attributes) Upstream `# check=`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--directives--check))
- `escape` (String) Upstream `# escape=`.
- `syntax` (String) Upstream `# syntax=`.

<a id="nestedatt--directives--check"></a>
### Nested Schema for `directives.check`

Read-Only:

- `error` (Boolean) Upstream `# check=error=<boolean>`.
- `skip` (List of String) Build-check rule names (21 at frontend 1.28; InvalidDefinitionDescription is experimental) or `all`.



<a id="nestedatt--exposed_ports"></a>
### Nested Schema for `exposed_ports`

Read-Only:

- `port` (String) Upstream `<port>`.
- `protocol` (String) Default `tcp`.


<a id="nestedatt--global_args"></a>
### Nested Schema for `global_args`

Read-Only:

- `default` (String, Sensitive) Upstream `<default value>`. Sensitive.
- `name` (String) Upstream `<name>`.


<a id="nestedatt--history"></a>
### Nested Schema for `history`

Read-Only:

- `comment` (String) Upstream `Comment`.
- `created` (Number) Upstream `Created`.
- `created_by` (String, Sensitive) Upstream `CreatedBy`. Sensitive.
- `id` (String) Upstream `Id`.
- `size` (Number) Upstream `Size`.
- `tags` (List of String) Upstream `Tags`.


<a id="nestedatt--stages"></a>
### Nested Schema for `stages`

Read-Only:

- `base_image` (String) As written (after global ARG substitution where resolvable).
- `base_image_digest` (String) Digest written in FROM (`@sha256:...`); the data source does not resolve tags.
- `base_image_ref` (String) Normalized `registry/repo:tag` of the base image (implicit `latest` added); null for scratch or a stage base.
- `base_stage` (String) Name of an earlier stage this stage builds on; null for an image base.
- `index` (Number) Upstream `(stage position)`.
- `instructions` (Attributes List) Upstream `(instructions after FROM)`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--stages--instructions))
- `name` (String) Upstream `AS <name>`.
- `platform` (String) Upstream `FROM --platform`.
